2608.19738.title: Learning to Beat: Phenotype-Guided Latent Flow with Regional Motion Priors for Biventricular Motion Synthesis
2608.19738.paper_summary: Full-cycle biventricular geometry is essential for characterizing cardiac function. However, dense and temporally consistent 3D+t biventricular meshes are not routinely available, whereas end-diastolic (ED) anatomy can often be obtained reliably. We therefore investigate full-cycle biventricular motion synthesis from a single ED mesh. This task is challenging because cardiac deformation is spatially heterogeneous and phenotype dependent, while conventional global generative models often obscure localized motion patterns. In this study, we propose a region-specific and phenotype-adaptive framework that integrates motion-informed functional parcellation with conditional latent flow. A functional partition learned from reconstructed motion organizes the ventricular surface into regions with coherent dynamics and enables topology-aware regional feature exchange. A phenotype-conditioned rectified-flow model subsequently maps the ED anatomy to full-cycle motion latents through fine-grained conditioning and prototype-routed motion adapters. An optional control branch further incorporates available motion descriptors for controllable synthesis. Experiments on ACDC, M\&Ms, and M\&Ms-2 demonstrate consistent improvements in geometric accuracy and functional fidelity. Under ED-only synthesis, our method achieves biventricular ASSD, HD95, and vRMSE of \(1.49\pm0.34\)~mm, \(3.77\pm1.06\)~mm, and \(3.31\pm1.03\)~mm, respectively, outperforming all competing methods. Complementary functional and robustness evaluations further demonstrate that the synthesized sequences preserve physiologically plausible ventricular dynamics and generalize across cohorts and disease phenotypes. The code will be released publicly upon acceptance of the manuscript for publication.
2608.19738.paper_summary_zh: 全週期雙心室幾何形狀對於表徵心臟功能至關重要。<lb/>然而，密集且時間一致的3D+t雙心室網格並不常規可用，而舒張末期（ED）解剖結構通常可以可靠地獲得。<lb/>因此，我們研究從單一ED網格合成全週期雙心室運動。<lb/>這一任務具有挑戰性，因為心臟變形在空間上是異質的，並且依賴於表型，而傳統的全局生成模型往往會掩蓋局部運動模式。<lb/>在這項研究中，我們提出了一個區域特定和表型自適應的框架，該框架將運動信息驅動的功能劃分與條件潛在流整合在一起。<lb/>從重建運動中學習的功能劃分將心室表面組織成具有一致動力學的區域，並使拓撲意識的區域特徵交換成為可能。<lb/>隨後，基於表型的修正流模型通過細粒度條件和原型路由運動適配器將ED解剖結構映射到全週期運動潛變量。<lb/>一個可選的控制分支進一步整合可用的運動描述符，以實現可控的合成。<lb/>在ACDC、M&Ms和M&Ms-2上的實驗顯示幾何準確性和功能保真度的一致改善。<lb/>在僅使用ED合成的情況下，我們的方法達到了雙心室ASSD、HD95和vRMSE分別為\(1.49\pm0.34\)~mm、\(3.77\pm1.06\)~mm和\(3.31\pm1.03\)~mm，超越了所有競爭方法。<lb/>補充的功能和穩健性評估進一步證明，合成的序列保留了生理上合理的心室動力學，並在不同的群體和疾病表型中具有良好的泛化能力。<lb/>代碼將在手稿接受出版後公開釋出。
